purpose: Frozen Arm-0 reference config for Mind2Web target-discrimination validation. See docs/stage9-mind2web-validation.md.

pooled_stat_path.note: DoG-reconstructed sampling path. Not the MIP fallback (sampleMIPPooled at line 628). file_blob_sha is the git blob SHA (git hash-object) — any edit to the file invalidates it. signature_prefix is grepped from the live file at the pinned line to catch function renames and signature changes. Step 3 wires the capability-detect branch to throw if MIP fallback is silently substituted at runtime.

modes_json_drift_pin.note: Blob SHA of shared/modes.json at freeze. validateLive() re-reads the file and compares. Catches the mode-15-style silent drift where pipeline knobs are edited without updating the Arm-0 snapshot.

feature_congestion_path.note: Rosenholtz 2007 Feature Congestion computation. Per-channel local variance at sigma=2.5 on Oklab I/|a|/|b| decompositions of the peripheral-rendered PNG. Constants match scripts/export-saliency.js computeSaliencyMaps(). validateLive() checks the blob SHA.

pooled_stat_vector.note: 7-D vector. RGBA sampled at candidate screen-space bbox center on the peripheral-rendered PNG. Three FC channels computed over the full 1280x768 rendered frame with sigma=2.5, then normalized to [0,1] by per-frame max. surround(c) = annulus-mean over all 7 dims at the retinotopic pool radius.

pool_constants_note: Schwartz CMF e0 and Rosenholtz pool-size constants are not separate knobs — both are encoded in pipeline.cmf_a (2.78) and pipeline.ecc_scaling (0.75). Schwartz M(e) = log(1 + e/cmf_a); pool-radius schedule c[k] = cmf_a * (exp(k*0.5*scale) - 1) / fovea_deg with scale = cortical_max / maxMipLevel / (ecc_scaling / 0.75). See peripheral.frag lines 322-338, 558-561.

surround.description: Pooled-statistics window that the peripheral model itself assigns to the cortical patch subtending candidate c, given gaze g. Distinctiveness asks whether c stands out from the local-pool average specified by the model's own geometry.
